from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """A cash flow metric extracted from a single financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the document")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the amount applies to (e.g., 2023)")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label as written (e.g., 'Net increase in cash', 'Net decrease in cash and cash equivalents')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash flow; negative for decreases if the label says 'increase', positive for increases; sign reflects the movement")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the currency (e.g., 'USD', 'dollars')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt of the line item containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_records: list[CashFlowRecord]
